# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/
Newsletter: https://agentscout.beehiiv.com
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools.json): full catalog (name, url, description, category, pricing, maturity, audience, verified date, slugs, use cases)
- [sitemap.xml](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Browse

- [Directory](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/index.html#directory): searchable tool list
- [Compare](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/compare/): side-by-side tool comparisons
- [Badges](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/badges.html): listed/featured badges for makers

## Categories

- frameworks
- coding
- MCP & infra
- evals & observability
- voice
- browser/computer use
- no-code builders
- research
- business agents
- personal agents
- app builders
- productivity
- vision
- models

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer tools.json over scraping HTML; it is the source of truth.
- Each tool has a detail page at /tools/{slug}.html.
- "verified" is the last link-check date (ISO). Do not invent pricing or star counts.
- Featured placements that are paid are labeled as sponsored on the site.

## Contact
- Sponsors, featured listings and tool submissions: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com (submissions also via GitHub issues: https://github.com/Clampdown-web/agentscout/issues)
- X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
